description: Human pilot mode (docs/human_pilot_mode.md): a person flies the vehicle from the front and down views (cameras with the pose and field of view of the policy's, shown at a higher resolution; or the simulator's window with --unreal-view) and the sentence, with the policy's three axes, and the flight is recorded in the format of the teacher's recordings, with the policy's own 256 x 256 pictures. Nothing here changes a model, a gate or an earlier result.
layouts_from: the recording layouts of every generic landing stage (configs/generic_landing_stage1d.json, layouts.train). The layouts checks are flown in (t, u, p, q, r, s) and the canonical ones (e, g, h, i, j) are refused.
distance_from: the validated range of the canonical evaluation (44 m); 12 m keeps the object out of reach of the first decision
acceleration_from: eases a key press in without making the vehicle wait for it: 0 to 2 m/s forward in 0.5 s, a full turn rate (24 deg/s) in 0.14 s. The vehicle's own response (about 2.4 s to follow a change of velocity) is the simulator's and is not changed: the recorded flights must move as a policy's flights move.
terminal_from: configs/visual_search.json stop_ticks: a policy ends a flight by giving the stop four decisions in a row; the teacher's recordings end the same way
boost_from: tier 4, for getting somewhere: faster than a policy can fly (2 m/s, 1 m/s, 24 deg/s). Every decision flown faster than a policy can, or backward, is recorded and marked; none is a label.
view_from: two display cameras with the pose and the field of view (90 deg) of the policy's front and down cameras, at 768 x 768 instead of 256 x 256; the recorded pictures are the policy's 256 x 256
